decisions.reason: The multifunctional handle remains a strategic accessibility option that costs little to keep while its demand uncertainty resolves.
After another year without signs of differentiation and with similar options already in the portfolio, its option value is too low to justify continued investment.
The German Design Award collection has already revealed strong value, so the option is clearly worth retaining.
The bronze finish remains a low-cost option that can enhance other products, so it is kept open while demand remains uncertain.
